extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.2.3: "Search for sources again" and "Play next episode" in the context menu no longer ask "Resume from…" twice: Kodi's own question is turned off for them, leaving SpongeTV's, which uses your resume point from Trakt. 1.2.2: Release 2, stage 2, part 2. When a search finds nothing ready to play, SpongeTV offers to have Premiumize download the best torrent it hasn't cached (by your sort order and filter), to wait for or download in the background; this works with Hide sources Premiumize hasn't cached on. In Source Select, the highlighted source's release name and details scroll when they're too long, and the details now start with the pack type and seeds, then tags such as HDR. 1.2.1: Deleting the SpongeTV folder in your Premiumize cloud no longer stops the caching assistant with "target folder not found": SpongeTV now makes the folder again and starts the download. 1.2.0: Release 2, stage 2, part 1: the caching assistant. Choosing a torrent Premiumize hasn't cached in Source Select now asks whether to download it and wait (a progress window, then it plays), download it in the background (SpongeTV tells you when it's ready, even after Kodi restarts), or cancel. Downloads go into a SpongeTV folder in your Premiumize cloud; one that makes no progress for 3 hours is cancelled. It can be turned off in Settings, Accounts, Premiumize. Uncached sources only show in Source Select with Hide sources Premiumize hasn't cached turned off. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
